title: Chapter 20. Appendix. Padas signed "Narahari" from the Gaura-pada-tarangini — IV: the appearance of Gaura, the end of childhood, the samskaras and the betrothal
html:
Continuation of the appendix (the introductory note on the two Naraharis, on the arguments for attribution and on the marks in the headings is in ch. 17). Chapter 20: a pada surveying Gaura's lila from the section "aishvarya and madhurya" (GPT 1.3); padas on the appearance of the Lord (section 2.1); the last padas of the section "Balya-lila" (2.2); the beginning of the section "Karnavedha and the wedding" (2.3) — the first tonsure and ear-piercing, the upanayana, the first meeting with Lakshmipriya by the Ganga, the news of the wedding and the adhivasa (the wedding day follows in the next chapter). Almost all the padas of the chapter are quoted by Narahari Chakravarti in the 12th wave of the Bhakti-ratnakara, where Ishana shows Srinivasa the house of Jagannatha Mishra and tells what happened there (two are in Chakravarti's Gaura-charita-chintamani); one pada (no. 12) has not been found in any witness. According to Majumdar, the padas on the birth and childhood of Nimai known under the name "Narahari" are late: Narahari Sarakara did not see the Lord's childhood. Before translation the "Narahari" signatures in sections 1.3 and 2.1–2.3 were checked throughout in GPT1: the catalogue had missed five more padas of section 2.3 (here nos. 13 and 15, new rows NG-280, 281; NG-282…284 follow in the next chapter). The base text is GPT1 (doubtful places from the scan), collated with GPT2, the BR (eds. 1912 and 1960) and the Gaura-charita-chintamani (ed. 1947); PK, KGC, PS and the Gita-chandrodaya have been checked. On the "birth" of the Lord see note 4; on the childhood games as lila, note 2 of chapter 19; on the samskaras, note 26. The notes of the GPT editors are not reproduced.

1. Narahari — "śacīsuta gaurahari…" (GPT1 p. 26, section 1.3, no. 2; BR)

A survey of the lila: the son of Shachi appeared in Navadvipa and revealed sankirtana; He took sannyasa, remained in Nilachala and, intoxicated with Radhika's love, intoxicated the world with it; His associates are beside themselves with prema; the treasure unattainable even for the gods He gave to the world. Raga kamoda. Attribution: probably Chakravarti — the pada is in the BR (12th wave).1

শচীসুত গৌরহরি, নবদ্বীপে অবতরি, করিলেন বিবিধ বিলাস ।
সঙ্গে লৈয়া প্রিয়গণ, প্রকাশিয়া সংকীর্ত্তন, বাঢ়াইলা সবার উল্লাস ॥

śacīsuta gaurahari, nabadvīpe abatari, karilena bibidha bilāsa |
saṅge laiyā priyagaṇa, prakāśiyā saṃkīrttana, bāṛhāilā sabāra ullāsa ||

śacī-suta gaurahari — Shachi's son Gaurahari; nabadvīpe abatari — descending in Navadvipa; karilena bibidha bilāsa — displayed manifold pastimes; saṅge laiyā priyagaṇa — taking His dear ones with Him; prakāśiyā saṅkīrtana — revealing sankirtana; bāṛhāilā sabāra ullāsa — increased the joy of all

1.1The son of Shachi, Gaurahari, having descended in Navadvipa, displayed manifold pastimes: together with His dear associates He revealed sankirtana and increased the joy of all.

কিবা সে সন্ন্যাস বেশে, ভ্রমি প্রভু দেশে দেশে, নীলাচলে আসিয়া রহিলা ।
রাধিকার প্রেমে মাতি, না জানি দিবারাতি, সে প্রেমে জগত মাতাইলা ॥

kibā se sannyāsa beśe, bhrami prabhu deśe deśe, nīlācale āsiyā rahilā |
rādhikāra preme māti, nā jāni dibārāti, se preme jagata mātāilā ||

kibā se sannyāsa beśe — and then in the dress of a sannyasi; bhrami prabhu deśe deśe — the Lord wandering from land to land; nīlācale āsiyā rahilā — came to Nilachala and remained; rādhikāra preme māti — intoxicated with Radhika's love; nā jāni dibārāti — knowing neither day nor night; se preme jagata mātāilā — intoxicated the world with that love

1.2And then, in the dress of a sannyasi, the Lord wandered from land to land and, coming to Nilachala, remained there; intoxicated with Radhika's love, knowing neither day nor night, He intoxicated the whole world with that love.2

নিত্যানন্দ বলরাম, অদ্বৈত গুণের ধাম, গদাধর শ্রীবাসাদি যত ।
দেখি সে অদ্ভুত রীতি, কেহ না ধরয়ে ধৃতি, প্রেমায় বিহ্বল অবিরত ॥

nityānanda balarāma, advaita guṇera dhāma, gadādhara śrībāsādi yata |
dekhi se adbhuta rīti, keha nā dharaye dhṛti, premāya bihvala abirata ||

nityānanda balarāma — Nityananda who is Balarama; advaita guṇera dhāma — Advaita, abode of virtues; gadādhara śrībāsādi yata — Gadadhara, Srivasa and all the rest; dekhi se adbhuta rīti — seeing that wondrous way; keha nā dharaye dhṛti — no one keeps composure; premāya bihvala abirata — ceaselessly overwhelmed with prema

1.3Nityananda who is Balarama, Advaita the abode of virtues, Gadadhara, Srivasa and all the rest, seeing this wondrous way, cannot keep their composure — ceaselessly overwhelmed with prema.

দেবের দুর্ল্লভ রত্ন, মিলাইলা করি যত্ন, কৃপার বালাই লৈয়া মরি ।
কৈলা কলিযুগ ধন্য, প্রভু কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য, যশ গায় দাস নরহরি ॥

debera durllabha ratna, milāilā kari yatna, kṛpāra bālāi laiyā mari |
kailā kaliyuga dhanya, prabhu kṛṣṇacaitanya, yaśa gāya dāsa narahari ||

debera durlabha ratna — the treasure hard to obtain even for the gods; milāilā kari yatna — bestowed with effort; kṛpāra bālāi laiyā mari — may I die taking on myself all ill [threatening such] mercy; kailā kali-yuga dhanya — made the age of Kali blessed; prabhu kṛṣṇa-caitanya — the Lord Krishna-Chaitanya; yaśa gāya dāsa narahari — Narahari Dasa sings the glory

1.4The treasure unattainable even for the gods He has, with effort, bestowed [on us] — may I die warding off all ill from such mercy! The Lord Krishna-Chaitanya has blessed the age of Kali — Narahari Dasa sings His glory.

(catalogue: NG-003). BR — 12th wave (ed. 1912, p. 914; ed. 1960, vv. 3605–3608): Ishana, having told Srinivasa of the Lord's departure from Navadvipa to Puri, quotes this pada as a brief survey of His whole lila. Variant: the BR has "bilāilā" — "distributed", the GPT "milāilā" — "procured, bestowed". Not in PK, KGC, PS, the Gita-chandrodaya or the Gaura-charita-chintamani. B. Nityananda is Balarama Himself (1.3; CC Adi 5).

2. Narahari — "phālguna-pūrṇimā śubhakṣaṇe…" (GPT1 p. 59, section 2.1, no. 19; BR)

In the auspicious hour of the full moon of Phalguna Shachi, having given birth to a son, cannot gaze at Him enough; Jagannatha Mishra, hearing the news, floats in an ocean of happiness and performs the rites; the Ganga and the Earth forget their sorrows; with the rising of Gaurachandra the darkness of sin departs. Raga vasanta. Attribution: probably Chakravarti — the pada is in the BR (12th wave).3

ফাল্গুন-পূর্ণিমা শুভক্ষণে । পুত্র প্রসবিয়া শচী চাহে পুত্রপানে ॥

phālguna-pūrṇimā śubhakṣaṇe | putra prasabiyā śacī cāhe putrapāne ||

phālguna-pūrṇimā śubha-kṣaṇe — in the auspicious hour of the Phalguna full moon; putra prasabiyā śacī — Shachi, having borne a son; cāhe putra-pāne — gazes at the son

2.1In the auspicious hour of the full moon of Phalguna Shachi, having given birth to a son, cannot take her eyes from Him.4

তিলে তিলে কত উঠে চিতে । কনকনবনী ভ্রমে নারে পরশিতে ॥

tile tile kata uṭhe cite | kanakanabanī bhrame nāre paraśite ||

tile tile — at every moment; kata uṭhe cite — how much rises in the heart; kanaka-nabanī bhrame — as if [He were] golden fresh butter; nāre paraśite — cannot touch

2.2How many feelings rise in her heart at every moment! As if He were golden fresh butter, she dares not touch Him.

কত না যতনে কোলে করে । পুত্রের জনম জানাইয়া মিশ্রবরে ॥

kata nā yatane kole kare | putrera janama jānāiyā miśrabare ||

kata nā yatane — with what care; kole kare — takes on her lap; putrera janama jānāiyā — making known the son's birth; miśra-bare — to the best of the Mishras

2.3With what care she takes Him on her lap and sends word of the son's birth to the best of the Mishras.

জগন্নাথ বিপ্রশিরোমণি । ভাসে সুখসমুদ্রে পুত্রের জন্ম শুনি ॥

jagannātha bipraśiromaṇi | bhāse sukhasamudre putrera janma śuni ||

jagannātha bipra-śiromaṇi — Jagannatha, crown of brahmanas; bhāse sukha-samudre — floats in an ocean of happiness; putrera janma śuni — hearing of the son's birth

2.4Jagannatha, the crown of brahmanas, hearing of the birth of his son, floats in an ocean of happiness.

কত সাধে চলয়ে ধাইয়া । না ধরে ধৈরজ চাঁদমুখ নিরখিয়া ॥

kata sādhe calaye dhāiyā | nā dhare dhairaja cām̐damukha nirakhiyā ||

kata sādhe — with what eagerness; calaye dhāiyā — goes running; nā dhare dhairaja — cannot keep composure; cām̐da-mukha nirakhiyā — beholding the moonlike face

2.5With what joy he hastens [to the son] — and, seeing the moonlike face, cannot contain himself.

লইয়া আপন প্রিয়গণে । করয়ে মঙ্গল কর্ম্ম পুত্রের কল্যাণে ॥

laiyā āpana priyagaṇe | karaye maṅgala karmma putrera kalyāṇe ||

laiyā āpana priyagaṇe — gathering his dear ones; karaye maṅgala karma — performs auspicious rites; putrera kalyāṇe — for the son's welfare

2.6Gathering his dear ones, he performs auspicious rites for the welfare of the son.

চতুর্দ্দিকে জয় জয়ধ্বনি । সবে কহে ধন্য ধন্য জনক জননী ॥

caturddike jaya jayadhvani | sabe kahe dhanya dhanya janaka jananī ||

caturdike — on all sides; jaya jaya-dhvani — cries of "jaya, jaya"; sabe kahe — all say; dhanya dhanya janaka jananī — blessed, blessed are father and mother

2.7On all sides sounds "jaya, jaya"; all say: "Blessed, blessed are the father and the mother!"

সবার অন্তরে বাঢ়ে সুখ । সুরধুনী ধরণী বিসরে সব দুখ ॥

sabāra antare bāṛhe sukha | suradhunī dharaṇī bisare saba dukha ||

sabāra antare — in everyone's heart; bāṛhe sukha — happiness grows; suradhunī dharaṇī — the Suradhuni (Ganga) and the Earth; bisare saba dukha — forget all sorrow

2.8Happiness grows in everyone's heart; the Suradhuni and the Earth forget all their sorrows.5

দশদিক্ হইল উজ্জ্বল । পশুপক্ষী বৃক্ষলতা প্রফুল্ল সকল ॥

daśadik haila ujjvala | paśupakṣī bṛkṣalatā praphulla sakala ||

daśa-dik haila ujjvala — the ten directions became bright; paśu-pakṣī bṛkṣa-latā — beasts, birds, trees, creepers; praphulla sakala — all blossomed

2.9All ten directions have become bright; beasts, birds, trees and creepers — all have blossomed.

নরহরি কি কহিবে আর । গৌরচন্দ্রোদয়ে গেল পাপ-অন্ধকার ॥

narahari ki kahibe āra | gauracandrodaye gela pāpa-andhakāra ||

narahari ki kahibe āra — what more will Narahari say; gauracandrodaye — at the rising of Gaurachandra; gela pāpa-andhakāra — the darkness of sin went away

2.10What more can Narahari say? With the rising of Gaurachandra the darkness of sin has gone.

(new row NG-276). BR — 12th wave (ed. 1912, p. 764; ed. 1960, vv. 907–916): Ishana, showing Srinivasa the place of the Lord's appearance in the house of Jagannatha Mishra, quotes padas of Vasu Ghosha and Vrindavana Dasa on the birth and then — in a row — this one and the next four (nos. 3–5; between them a pada signed by Ghanashyama, GPT 2.1 no. 23, outside the appendix) and no. 6. Variant in the last line: the BR has "the darkness of suffering" (tāpa), the GPT "the darkness of sin" (pāpa). Not in PK, KGC, PS, the Gita-chandrodaya or the Gaura-charita-chintamani. B. The GPT1 footnotes to lines 2.8–2.9 (editor's notes) are not reproduced. in a material body: He appears (avirbhava) by His own will in His eternal form — as Krishna appeared before Devaki (Bhag. 10.3; Gita 4.6, 4.9; CC Adi 13–14). So the appearance of the Lord is understood by Vrindavana Dasa, Krishnadasa Kaviraja and Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati; so too are all the padas on the "birth" in this chapter to be understood. burdened with the sins of the age of Kali, forgot their sorrows: on the banks of the Ganga He will perform His pastimes, and the sins of the world will depart.

3. Narahari — "phālguna-pūrṇimā maṅgalera sīmā…" (GPT1 pp. 59–60, no. 20; BR)

The full moon of Phalguna: the Moon of Gokula has appeared, in every house of Nadia there is an ocean of joy; Shachi with her son on her lap in the birth-chamber; in the darkness of the eclipse crowds run to see the Child and forget themselves. Raga not stated (in the BR — dhanashi). Attribution: probably Chakravarti — the pada is in the BR.6

ফাল্গুন-পূর্ণিমা, মঙ্গলের সীমা, প্রকট গোকুল-ইন্দু ।
নদীয়ানগরে, প্রতি ঘরে ঘরে, উথলে আনন্দসিন্ধু ॥

phālguna-pūrṇimā, maṅgalera sīmā, prakaṭa gokula-indu |
nadīyānagare, prati ghare ghare, uthale ānandasindhu ||

phālguna-pūrṇimā — the Phalguna full moon; maṅgalera sīmā — the summit of blessings; prakaṭa gokula-indu — the Moon of Gokula has appeared; nadīyā-nagare — in the town of Nadia; prati ghare ghare — in every house; uthale ānanda-sindhu — an ocean of joy surges

3.1The full moon of Phalguna — the summit of all blessings: the Moon of Gokula has appeared! In the town of Nadia, in every house, an ocean of joy surges.

কিবা কৌতুক পরস্পরে ।
শচীদেবী ভালে, পুত্র লৈয়া কোলে, বিলসে সূতিকাঘরে ॥ ধ্রু ॥

kibā kautuka paraspare |
śacīdebī bhāle, putra laiyā kole, bilase sūtikāghare || dhru ||

kibā kautuka paraspare — what merriment among them; śacī-debī bhāle — Shachi-devi splendidly; putra laiyā kole — taking her son on her lap; bilase sūtikā-ghare — shines in the birth-chamber

3.2What merriment among them all!
Shachi-devi, taking her son on her lap, shines in the birth-chamber.

বালকে দেখিতে, ধায় চারিভিতে, কেহ না ধরয়ে ধৃতি ।
গ্রহণান্ধকারে, কে চিনে কাহারে, অসংখ্য লোকের গতি ॥

bālake dekhite, dhāya cāribhite, keha nā dharaye dhṛti |
grahaṇāndhakāre, ke cine kāhāre, asaṃkhya lokera gati ||

bālake dekhite — to see the Child; dhāya cāri-bhite — they run from all sides; keha nā dharaye dhṛti — no one restrains himself; grahaṇa-andhakāre — in the darkness of the eclipse; ke cine kāhāre — who knows whom; asaṃkhya lokera gati — the coming of countless people

3.3To see the Child they run from all sides — no one can restrain himself; in the darkness of the eclipse who can tell who is who? There is no counting the people coming.7

বালক-মাধুরী, দেখি আঁখি ভরি, পাসরে আপন দেহা ।
নরহরি কয়, শচীর তনয়, প্রকাশে কি নব লেহা ॥

bālaka-mādhurī, dekhi ām̐khi bhari, pāsare āpana dehā |
narahari kaya, śacīra tanaya, prakāśe ki naba lehā ||

bālaka-mādhurī — the Child's sweetness; dekhi ām̐khi bhari — seeing to their eyes' fill; pāsare āpana dehā — they forget their own bodies; narahari kaya — Narahari says; śacīra tanaya — Shachi's son; prakāśe ki naba lehā — reveals what new love

3.4Gazing their fill at the sweetness of the Child, they forget their own bodies.
Narahari says: the son of Shachi reveals some new love!

12th wave (ed. 1912, pp. 764–765; ed. 1960, vv. 917–920, "punardhānaśī"). Not in PK, KGC, PS, the Gita-chandrodaya or the Gaura-charita-chintamani. B. Line 3.2 is the refrain (dhru). repeating the name of Hari (CC Adi 13; CB Adi 2–3; Murari 1.5). "The Moon of Gokula" is Krishna: Gaura is Krishna Himself, the Lord of Gokula.

4. Narahari — "parama śubha śacīgarbhe…" (GPT1 p. 60, no. 21; BR)

Gaura, the Lord of Gokula, in the womb of Shachi; the gods praise Him; on the night of the full moon, when Rahu had swallowed the moon, the Lord appeared, having first revealed His name; those entering Mishra's house, seeing the Child, lose their senses; the pride of Kali is crushed. Raga kamoda. Attribution: probably Chakravarti — the pada is in the BR; Vrajabuli.8

পরম শুভ শচীগর্ভে বিলসত গৌর গোকুল নাহ ।
করই স্তুতিনতি দেবগণ ঘন, ভবনে ভরই উছাহ ॥

parama śubha śacīgarbhe bilasata gaura gokula nāha |
karai stutinati debagaṇa ghana, bhabane bharai uchāha ||

parama śubha — in the supremely auspicious [hour]; śacī-garbhe bilasata — abides in Shachi's womb; gaura gokula nāha — Gaura, the Lord of Gokula; karaï stuti-nati debagaṇa ghana — the gods again and again praise and bow; bhabane bharaï uchāha — jubilation fills the house

4.1In the womb of Shachi, in the supremely auspicious hour, abides Gaura — the Lord of Gokula; again and again the gods offer praises and bow down; the house brims with jubilation.

শুভগ ফাল্গুন-পূর্ণিমানিশি শশী উদয়ে রাহু গরাসি ।
ঐছে সময়ে প্রকাশে পহুঁ নিজ নাম পহিলে প্রকাশি ॥

śubhaga phālguna-pūrṇimāniśi śaśī udaye rāhu garāsi |
aiche samaye prakāśe pahum̐ nija nāma pahile prakāśi ||

śubhaga phālguna-pūrṇimā-niśi — on the auspicious night of the Phalguna full moon; śaśī udaye rāhu garāsi — Rahu swallowing the rising moon; aiche samaye — at such a time; prakāśe pahum̐ — the Lord appeared; nija nāma pahile prakāśi — having first revealed His own name

4.2On the auspicious night of the Phalguna full moon, when Rahu had swallowed the rising moon — at such an hour the Lord appeared, having first revealed His name.9

হোত জয় জয়কার জগভরি ধিরজ ধরত ন কোই ।
মিশ্রভবনে প্রবেশি শিশু, অবলোকি উনমত হোই ॥

hota jaya jayakāra jagabhari dhiraja dharata na koi |
miśrabhabane prabeśi śiśu, abaloki unamata hoi ||

hota jaya jayakāra jaga-bhari — "jaya, jaya" sounds through the world; dhiraja dharata na koi — no one keeps composure; miśra-bhabane prabeśi — entering Mishra's house; śiśu abaloki — beholding the Child; unamata hoi — they go mad [with joy]

4.3"Jaya, jaya" resounds through the whole world, no one can restrain himself;
those entering Mishra's house, beholding the Child, go mad with happiness.

বিবিধ মঙ্গল, রচই নব নব, সব মনোরথ পূর ।
ভণত নরহরি, বিপুলবলী কলি গরবভরে ভেল চূর ॥

bibidha maṅgala, racai naba naba, saba manoratha pūra |
bhaṇata narahari, bipulabalī kali garababhare bhela cūra ||

bibidha maṅgala racaï naba naba — they perform various auspicious rites, ever new; saba manoratha pūra — all desires are fulfilled; bhaṇata narahari — Narahari says; bipula-balī kali — mighty Kali; garaba-bhare bhela cūra — his pride is crushed

4.4They perform various auspicious rites, ever new; all desires are fulfilled.
Narahari says: the pride of mighty Kali is crushed.
